handbook: (Handbook 2025) Travel reimbursement requests must be filed in the portal within 30 days of the trip.
(Handbook 2025) Portal accounts are locked after 5 failed password attempts.
(Notice, March 2026) Starting in March 2026, travel reimbursement requests must be filed within 15 days of the trip. This replaces the 30-day rule.
(Handbook 2025) The support desk answers on business days, from 8 am to 6 pm.
(Handbook 2025) The Lisbon office has 40 parking spaces; the Porto office has 25.
(Handbook 2025) Laptops are replaced every 4 years and monitors every 6 years.
(Handbook 2025) The Lisboa Street warehouse, which is not the Lisbon office, opens at 6 am.
(Security policy 2026) Passwords must have at least 14 characters.
ops: (IT policy 2024) VPN access requests are approved by the requester's manager and take effect on the next business day after approval.
(IT policy 2024) Contractors cannot request VPN access themselves: the project lead requests it for them, and contractor access expires after 90 days.
(HR handbook 2025) Employees accrue 2 vacation days per full month worked. New employees can take vacation only after completing 3 months.
(HR handbook 2025) Unused vacation days carry over to the next year up to a maximum of 10 days; any excess is lost on January 1.
(Finance notice, June 2025) Meal expenses are reimbursed up to 40 per day on domestic trips and 60 per day on international trips.
(Finance notice, January 2026) From February 1, 2026, the international meal limit rises to 75 per day. The domestic limit is unchanged.
(Facilities 2025) The Recife office is open from 7 am to 7 pm and the Natal office from 8 am to 6 pm. Both are closed on weekends.
(Facilities 2025) Meeting rooms with more than 10 seats must be booked at least 2 business days ahead.
(Security policy 2025) Production database credentials are rotated every 60 days; staging credentials every 180 days.
(Security policy 2025) A laptop reported lost must be wiped remotely within 4 hours of the report; if it held customer data, the privacy officer must also be notified within 24 hours.
(On-call guide 2025) Severity 1 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes and severity 2 incidents within 1 hour. Severity 3 incidents have no acknowledgement target.
(On-call guide 2025) The on-call engineer for the payments service comes from the Falcon team, which rotates its on-call engineer every Monday.
(Team directory 2025) The Falcon team is led by Marta Quintela. The Heron team, which runs the billing service, is led by Davi Lacerda.
(Team directory 2025) Teams with more than 8 members have a deputy lead. The Falcon team has 11 members and its deputy lead is Rui Antunes.
(Procurement 2025) Purchases above 5,000 need two quotes; purchases above 20,000 also need the CFO's approval.
(Procurement notice, March 2026) The two-quote threshold is lowered to 3,000. The CFO threshold is unchanged.
